description: Starter party. Copy this file and replace the names, date, venue, and words with your own. Then import it in Event Horizon.

venue.name: Your venue
venue.notes: Replace the world, district, ward, and plot. Delete ward and plot if this party is not in a house.

schedule.title: Welcome
schedule.hostNotes: Wait until the room has settled.

games.name: Send or Delete
games.description: The room guesses whether the guest would publish the line.
games.rules: Read the line. The room guesses SEND or DELETE. Reveal the answer yourself and award points by hand.

rounds.title: Round 1
rounds.explanation: Replace this with the real answer before the party.

extras.chirp: Replace this with the line you will read aloud.

scripts.title: Welcome
scripts.stageDirections: Let the room quiet down before you start.
scripts.spokenText: Welcome to My Party. I am your host. We have one game, then I will close the night. Say hello to someone new, and I will start when the room is ready.
scripts.announcement:
/yell Welcome to My Party. The doors are open.
/yell The game starts at 8:15. Grab a seat.

scripts.title: Game intro
scripts.spokenText: This game is called Send or Delete. I will read a line. You decide whether our guest would publish it. Shout SEND or DELETE, and I will reveal the answer after you guess.
scripts.announcement: /yell Send or Delete is starting. Guess SEND or DELETE.

scripts.title: Closing
scripts.spokenText: That is our night. Thank you for playing, and thank you for being kind on the way out. Good night.
scripts.announcement: /yell Thank you for coming to My Party. Good night.

prizes.notes: Hand this over yourself. The plugin does not trade.

notes.title: Before the party
notes.body: Change the date, the venue, the names, and the script. Import the file, then open it from the dashboard.

checklists.text: Set the prize where you can reach it
